evidence_class: local isolated fixture on temporary homes; mocked: the herdr CLI, the init-agent launch and the process reaper behind HerdrRuntime, and the remote backend is an in-memory fake; not live rollout proof

supported_versions.runtime_protocol: operations spawn, observe, command, drain, terminate, recover; statuses ok, ambiguous, unavailable, unsupported, refused; recovery modes reattach, resume
supported_versions.backends: local (LocalHerdrRuntime over HerdrRuntime); remote backends are fixtures only

interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.runtime.base: Capability, Status, Recovery, SpawnRequest, Outcome, Runtime, foreign, RuntimeRouter (spawn, observe, command, drain, terminate, recover, spawn_backend, capability_failures_total, from_environ)
scripts.swarm_v2.runtime.local.LocalHerdrRuntime: compatibility adapter over scripts.swarm.runtime.HerdrRuntime spawn, observe, nudge, retire, recover and resume
AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_BACKEND selects the spawn backend; AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_DISABLED lists backends to disable

states.observed: Local: the runtime protocol module and the existing herdr runtime suite passed; ruff check and format clean.
states.accepted: Cases A, B and C passed on a local and a remote fake with different capabilities; case A repeated on a second independent temporary home.
states.committed: The tested commit carries the code; the case results in this folder were generated on it.
states.externally_verified: pending CI on the pull request

rollback_rehearsal.action: AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_DISABLED=<backend> routes new spawns to the local adapter; existing attempt records keep their runtime_backend and their operations return unavailable
rollback_rehearsal.case: c: a disabled remote left its attempt record and runtime object unchanged, a new spawn went local, and re-enabling served the first object again without a duplicate

remaining_limitations: The tick and the swarm command line still call HerdrRuntime directly; moving those call sites onto RuntimeRouter belongs to SV2-RUN-02.
No remote backend exists yet; the remote runtime is a fixture.
runtime_capability_failures_total is an in-process counter on RuntimeRouter with no exporter.
No live rollout proof; the evidence is a local isolated fixture plus CI.
